# Animation API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/animation.json</code></div>

Clip, state-machine, skinned-mesh and sprite-sheet animation control.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.animation.playClip`

`playClip(entity, path) -> boolean`

Plays an animation clip on the entity.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `path` | string | Clip asset path. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.playClip(e, 'clips/run.anim')
```

### `caffeine.animation.playSkinnedClip`

`playSkinnedClip(entity, meshPath, clipIndex) -> boolean`

Plays a clip of a skinned mesh by index.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `meshPath` | string | Skinned mesh path. |
| `clipIndex` | number | Index of the clip in the mesh. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.playSkinnedClip(e, 'models/hero.glb', 0)
```

### `caffeine.animation.playState`

`playState(entity, state) -> boolean`

Switches the animator to a named state.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `state` | string | State name. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true on success.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.playState(e, 'Idle')
```

### `caffeine.animation.setSpriteSheet`

`setSpriteSheet(entity, columns, rows, frameCount) -> boolean`

Configures sprite-sheet animation on the entity.

|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |

### `caffeine.animation.attachRig2D`

`attachRig2D(entity, rigPath) -> boolean`

Attaches a 2D rig (bones, skinned mesh, parameters) to the entity. Replaces the rig if one is already attached and resets its clip.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `rigPath` | string | Path to a .rig2d file. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when the rig was attached.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.attachRig2D(e, "assets/hero.rig2d")
```

### `caffeine.animation.playRig2DClip`

`playRig2DClip(entity, clipPath) -> boolean`

Plays a parameter clip on the entity's rig from time zero. Parameters with the same name as PhaseShift floats are then overridden by the PhaseShift values.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `clipPath` | string | Path to a .pclip parameter clip. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when the clip was set. The rig must be attached first.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.playRig2DClip(e, "assets/hero_blink.pclip")
```

### `caffeine.animation.setSmoothing`

`setSmoothing(entity, name, smoothTime) -> boolean`

Smooths a float parameter with a critically damped spring. Transitions read the smoothed value, so blends are not abrupt.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | number | Entity id. |
| `name` | string | Name of a float parameter. |
| `smoothTime` | number | Seconds to reach the target. 0 turns smoothing off. |

**Returns:** `boolean` — true when the parameter exists and is a float.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.animation.setSmoothing(e, "speed", 0.15)
```
